title: Quantitative control and recording of materials-synthesis processes using an automated experimentation platform
summary: An automated experimentation platform produced ZIF-8 under three solution-dispensing speeds; DLS measurements showed a repeatable dependence of particle-size distribution on speed, and XRD confirmed ZIF-8 as the principal crystalline phase. A Gemini agent generated device-control code that was reviewed before execution. Limited conditions and repeats do not establish the mechanism.
ai_technology: A Gemini 3.5 Flash agent generates robot and device control code for a quantitatively controlled materials-synthesis experiment; authors review/validate generated code before execution.
organization: University of Liverpool; University of Manchester

source_review.scope: Primary full text, including Methods and Results; publication date and first result-bearing version checked.

evidence.tested: The primary preprint reports three dispensing-speed conditions, repeated synthesis, DLS particle-size measurements and XRD phase confirmation.
evidence.unknown: Only three speed conditions and limited independent repeats; DLS reports hydrodynamic size and does not resolve the mechanism.
